about: Every record the district-checks step moved (data/local/REPORT.md section 32), the working tree after the rebuild against the branch before it, stamps aside. Listed one by one: every record whose p was lost, gained or retyped, whose reason or note changed, or whose p moved by more than 1%. The records whose p moved by 1% or less, and nothing else but their forecasts and forecast inputs, are counted by level and year in p_moved_within_1pct: the fits and the chambers' leans lose the held districts, so every p fitted on them moves a little.

codes.G: a record no longer written (joined into another, or replaced)
codes.R: not computed before or after, the reason changed
